subject.title: Fix automatic quota display priority for exhausted windows & Antigravity session preference

question: Should Automatic mode intentionally change Antigravity’s two menu-bar lanes from Gemini plus Claude/GPT quotas to Gemini session plus Gemini weekly quotas?
rationale: The proposal deliberately changes what existing Antigravity users see and conflicts with the current secondary-lane label and compact-fallback contract; code review cannot safely choose that user-facing provider policy.

options.title: Keep current provider-family semantics
options.body: Land only the narrow exhausted-window repair and retain the current Gemini plus Claude/GPT automatic presentation until a separately approved redesign exists.

options.title: Adopt Gemini session/weekly semantics
options.body: Approve the new contract, update labels and migration behavior consistently, and add coverage for Gemini-only, Claude/GPT detail, and compact-fallback cases.

options.title: Defer the Antigravity change
options.body: Split the directional Antigravity and Pace % work out of this bug-fix PR for focused design review.

recommendation.title: Keep current provider-family semantics
recommendation.body: Land only the narrow exhausted-window repair and retain the current Gemini plus Claude/GPT automatic presentation until a separately approved redesign exists.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a visible provider-contract and persisted-layout product decision rather than a mechanical repair.
